header: RELEASE OF CLAIM AND SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT

blocks.text: RELEASE OF CLAIM AND SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT
This Release of Claim and Settlement Agreement ("Agreement") is made as of {{release_date}} between:
This Agreement resolves the dispute between the Parties described below:
The Parties have engaged in good-faith negotiations and have reached the following settlement.

rows: {{late_payment_interest}}% per month on any unpaid installment.

blocks.text: In consideration of the settlement amount and the mutual promises contained herein, Releasor hereby releases, waives, and forever discharges Releasee, and Releasee's officers, directors, employees, agents, affiliates, successors, assigns, and insurers (collectively, the "Released Parties"), from any and all claims, demands, actions, causes of action, liabilities, damages, losses, costs, and expenses of any kind whatsoever, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, that Releasor ever had, now has, or hereafter may have against the Released Parties, arising from or related to:

This release includes, but is not limited to, claims for personal injury, property damage, economic loss, intentional torts, negligence, gross negligence, and violations of statute. Releasor expressly waives any rights under California Civil Code § 1542 (or any similar provision in any jurisdiction), which provides: "A general release does not extend to claims that the creditor or releasing party does not know or suspect to exist in his or her favor at the time of executing the release and that, if known by him or her, would have materially affected his or her settlement with the debtor or released party."
This Agreement is a compromise of a disputed claim. Neither Party admits liability or fault. The settlement amount is not an admission of liability by Releasee.
The Parties agree to keep the terms and existence of this Agreement confidential. Neither Party shall disclose the terms to any third party, except:

items: As required by law, regulation, or court order.
To the Parties' attorneys, accountants, financial advisors, and insurance carriers, who are bound by confidentiality.
To the extent necessary to enforce this Agreement.

blocks.text: Each Party represents that they have not assigned, transferred, or otherwise disposed of any claim covered by this release to any third party. Each Party agrees not to file, initiate, or prosecute any claim covered by this release against the other Party.
If a dispute arises from this Agreement, the Parties agree to resolve it through {{dispute_resolution}} in {{governing_state}}.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}.

This Agreement constitutes the entire settlement of all claims between the Parties arising from the dispute described above. The Parties agree that this Agreement supersedes all prior negotiations, discussions, and agreements.
If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.
